acceptance_scope: Connected browser-assisted extraction review and manual-capture persistence, including mandatory field review, rejected optional values, and provenance readback.

environment.network: capture acceptance blocks external requests; no ATS/provider was contacted

behavior.review_gate: Manual job persistence rejects extraction payloads without a valid review receipt, required identity/description acknowledgements, all retained routes, and every low-confidence field.
behavior.user_visible_review: The confirmation step requires a separate acknowledgement of the extracted or manually supplied description; removed extracted values require an explicit removal acknowledgement.
behavior.durable_receipt: The saved posting retains the reviewed/rejected field lists, sanitized field values, per-field source/confidence/review state, and safe opaque capture reference.
behavior.rejection_recovery: An explicitly rejected optional application route is omitted from canonical routes and saved raw fields while source/confidence provenance remains; a remaining reviewed listing route can still be captured.
behavior.preservation: Changed extracted values still require user-corrected provenance; the unbounded capture payload is not persisted, sensitive URL query values/fragments are removed, and captured page instructions remain inert text data.
behavior.negative_controls: Missing/incomplete receipts, invalid provenance, unreconciled fields, and unreviewed removals fail without durable writes; capture performs no external access or application submission.

commands.result: PASS: TypeScript and Vite build; emitted the existing >500 kB chunk advisory (736.18 kB JavaScript).
PASS: 1 connected Chromium workflow, including review gating, retry, reload, and receipt/provenance readback
